The unique prey column in each row defines invertible positive monomial F and all others nonnegative V, giving M=F−V and M1=−a=d>0. K(lambda)=F^{-1}(V+lambda I) is nonnegative and irreducible for the strict signs (indeed positive off diagonal). The Collatz–Wielandt inequalities at lambda=min d and max d straddle spectral radius 1; continuous Perron radius yields lambda* in that interval with v>0, Mv=lambda*v and J(Dv)=lambda*(Dv). lambda*>0. Strict monotonicity of irreducible Perron root gives uniqueness among positive eigenvector eigenvalues, not spectral abscissa dominance. Explicit B=ones-(n+3)P, a_i=-3, x*=ones verifies feasible sharpness for any allowed cycle partition. Independent exact n=6 witness recovered eigenvalue 3.

originality.rationale: The closest 2026 ecological-cycle theorem gives an odd-number-of-cycles obstruction by a determinant parity argument; its even-cycle theorem adds a mutualistic pair, changing the sign pattern and vertex count. The present even pure-cycle proof supplies a positive real instability eigenvalue and mortality-range bounds, not derivable from those determinant statements. Classical nonnegative matrix techniques are generic ingredients, but exact applicability and quantitative bound are new best of knowledge.
